items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Interviewer mentions Buddy Bowling putting his horn out the window; Interviewee confirms the anecdote ('Yeah, he'd like to say...') but does not describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with Bowling.

ctx.x: They were both playing in the same ground. Same ground, yeah. Same ground. In Lincoln Park? Yes. One in the pavilion and the other on the skating rink. Yeah, sure. How far apart were the pavilion in the skating rink? Well, I'd say about 75 feet. Must have been a lot of music in that part.

And Bowling used to put his horn out the window and start blowing. Yeah. The minute he got into the place and they'd all leave Robichaud and traipse over to Bowling's. Yeah, he looked. And he said he was calling the children home.
Yeah, he'd like to say, well, boy, let's call our children home, you know. Put his horn away. Do,
